era: 1374 DR, Year of the Lightning Storms, six months after the Rage of Dragons
tone: Low fantasy. Rain. Hearth-smoke. People who have seen something burn and have not yet agreed to talk about it. Not heroic; never cinematic. Funny only when scared. Violence, when it comes, is fast and off-page.
notes: The setting is currently experiencing a three-day lightning storm. A recent mystery involves an empty Thayan strongbox, and the player character is tasked by a Harper to investigate its contents without recovering the object.
